title: Briefing DIA head General Patrick Hughes

tellings.quote: And I briefed a three-star general, Patrick Hughes.

plain: In the 1990s, a three-star general named Patrick Hughes, head of the Defense Intelligence Agency (the Pentagon's military spy agency), was briefed on UFOs. The briefing was given by Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for governments to release what they know about UFOs. Greer says he did it himself: "I briefed a three-star general, Patrick Hughes." If true, it would mean UFO claims reached the very top of military intelligence.
